verdict.summary: An LLM-agent design that sends Spotify Content, metadata, listening history, or playlist data into an AI/ML model is prohibited by Spotify's published policy. Do not implement or submit that design. Development Mode is limited to five allowlisted users. Production-scale Extended Quota Mode requires partner approval and is limited to organizations applying through a company email that meet Spotify's stated eligibility criteria, including a legally registered entity, active launched service, commercial viability, availability in key Spotify markets, Terms compliance, and at least 250,000 MAU. If the organization qualifies and submits a compliant non-ingesting design, expect review of up to six weeks.
verdict.activeEffort: 1–3 days (estimate), mostly implementing consent, token lifecycle, disconnect/deletion, and review materials
verdict.waitTime: Up to 6 weeks [official]; longer during peak periods and another 6-week SLA can apply after resubmission [community-reported]
verdict.mainGate: Spotify prohibits ingesting Spotify Content into an AI/ML model. For production-scale access, Extended Quota Mode also requires partner approval and eligibility as an organization, including a legally registered entity, active launched service, commercial viability, availability in key Spotify markets, Terms compliance, and at least 250,000 MAU.

recommendation.text: Do not launch a general LLM Spotify-content agent on the public Web API without written Spotify permission. For a permitted integration, use a confidential server-side Authorization Code application with one encrypted token set per Spotify account; keep the initial product to non-content AI workflows or deterministic user-authorized actions, then seek Extended Quota Mode only if the organization can meet Spotify's partner criteria.

essentials.text: Access tokens last 1 hour. Refresh tokens last 6 months from original authorization, and refreshing an access token does not extend that deadline; retain an old refresh token when no replacement is returned, and on invalid_grant discard it and restart authorization.
